packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript below 7: svelte-check only runs TS 7 with TS 6 installed alongside and the experimental --tsgo flag. Lift this once svelte-check supports TS 7 on its own.
Keep the release build container on ubuntu:24.04: packages built on a newer base need a newer glibc and stop running on 24.04 LTS, Mint 22 and Debian 13.
